# Well Skill Gurukul

> Professional education and skill-development institute dedicated to creating the next generation of skilled professionals, confident entrepreneurs, and responsible wellness leaders in beauty, wellness, health, lifestyle, and personal development.

## Core Information
- **Website**: https://wellskillgurukul.co.in/
- **Phone / WhatsApp Helpline**: +91 89105 12503
- **Admissions Email**: info@wellskillgurukul.co.in
- **Philosophy**: Learn • Practice • Transform • Lead ("Learn Skills. Build Careers. Create Impact.")
- **Headquarters / Operations**: India

## Vision & Mission
- **Vision**: To become a leading centre for beauty, wellness, and lifestyle education, creating skilled professionals, successful entrepreneurs, and a global community of wellness leaders.
- **Mission**: Deliver industry-oriented, practical, and skill-based education; develop job-ready and business-ready professionals; combine traditional knowledge with modern wellness practices; support learners with post-training mentorship and business growth frameworks.

## Core Programs & Services
1. **Nutrition & Lifestyle Program**: Evidence-based nutrition protocols, metabolic balance, meal planning, digestive wellness, and healthy daily routines.
2. **Corporate Wellness Program**: Equipping professionals to design, pitch, and execute high-impact workplace wellness sessions, ergonomic audits, and executive stress-reduction seminars.
3. **Weightloss Program**: Science-backed weight management combining metabolic conditioning, sustainable caloric balancing, and long-term behavioral adherence coaching.
4. **Certified Nutritionist and Lifestyle Coach**: Rigorous professional coach certification covering 1-on-1 client consultations, behavioral psychology, clinical dietary planning, and ethics.
5. **Wellness Business Mastery**: Startup-to-Brand mentorship covering business structuring, niche selection, service packaging, pricing, client acquisition, and scaling.
6. **Alternative & Integrative Therapy Workshop**: Hands-on practical workshops exploring Panchkarma therapies, naturopathy healing techniques, spa therapies, and integrative wellness modalities.

## Faculty & Experts
- **Dr. Anjali Sharma**: Senior Naturopathy Doctor & Academic Director (BNYS, MD Alternative Medicine)
